title: Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales
intro: Bedtime battles? Meet the gentlest stories on YouTube. Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales.
outro: Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales. Subscribe tonight, dim the lights, and snuggle in. Sweet dreams, little one.

text: Every tale is a complete picture book, read slowly and softly, page by page.
No flashing colours. No loud noises. Just calm.
Real Australian animals, painted in soft, dreamy watercolour.
Written specially for little ones, aged one to five.
Two to three minutes each. Just right for lights out.
